lead: Show the dashboard on a phone or a tablet of the same local network, as a second screen. The page only shows the dashboard: it sends nothing to a pane and changes nothing.
enable: Show the dashboard on the local network
scanStep: Scan this QR code with the phone or the tablet, or open the address below in its web browser.
copyTitle: Copy the address of the page
keySecret: The QR code and the address hold the pairing key: show them only to your own devices.
screenOn: The page uses plain HTTP, so it keeps the screen of the device on with a silent video: touch the page once after it opens.
firewall: The first time, macOS can ask whether Heidrun Code accepts incoming connections: click Allow.
newKeyTitle: The old QR code stops working at once: every device must scan the new QR code
error.cannotListen: Heidrun Code cannot listen on its port.
error.noNetwork: This computer has no address on a local network. Connect it to a Wi-Fi network or to a network cable.
